gaps.code_switching: no es-en code-switching slice: BrunoHays/Bangor-Miami-Spanish-English-Corpus is the only ungated corpus found, but it ships whole 30 min conversations with CHAT-annotated transcripts (xxx, www, &=laugh, overlap codes) and no timestamps, so there is no trustworthy reference that can be cut to item length
